prompt: User sends https://martinfowler.com/bliki/ValueObject.html — agent captures with full deep analysis pipeline

assertions.name: frontmatter_completeness
assertions.text: Note has YAML frontmatter with title, source URL, source_type: web, captured timestamp (ISO 8601 +09:00), tags array, ai_summary

assertions.name: deep_analysis_sections
assertions.text: Note body contains structured sections: 핵심 주장, 주요 논거 및 근거, 인사이트, 실용적 시사점

assertions.name: vault_connection_wikilink
assertions.text: Note references existing DDD Aggregate note via Obsidian wikilink [[...]] in 볼트 연결 section

assertions.name: filename_format
assertions.text: File saved as YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-slug.md with ASCII-only slug, max 60 chars

assertions.name: classification_existing_label
assertions.text: Classification recommendation labels resources/ddd-patterns as (기존) not (신규)

assertions.name: recommendation_summary
assertions.text: Recommendation includes concise summary lines for 핵심, 인사이트, 시사점
